attribution.note: Marcus states his own doubts about this capability; he is not attributing them to someone else.

semantics.note: The normalization turns serious doubt into a categorical negative and omits mastery of the basics. The scope and deadline remain intact, and no conditional antecedent is omitted.

contract.note: Declining to score respects the speaker's uncertainty. The wording of the statement itself suffices; the result need not depend on interpreting the later caveat.

output.rationale: Marcus expresses serious doubt rather than an unqualified commitment that this capability will be absent. Policy excludes probabilistic forecasts from scoring, even after their deadline. No outcome evidence was supplied, and the categorical normalization cannot substitute for his actual wording.
